description: Home Insurance Affordability and Socioeconomic Equity in a Changing Climate is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Actuaries Institute. This website and linked report (PDF), produced by the Actuaries Institute, examines home insurance affordability and socioeconomic equity under different climate change scenarios. This is done via a new index called the Australian Actuaries Home Insurance Affordability Index (AAHIA). The report overlays data on a low and high emissions scenario of climate change to project what affordability by household may look like in 2050. Coverage is Australia, 1971 to 2090; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-NC (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and climate adaptation planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
